configuration.rowGroupBoundaries: Identical for every writer and preserved from the source taxi file.
configuration.timingBoundary: Prepared writer execution through complete in-memory output, metadata, footer, and close. Input data and reusable Plank row-writer construction are excluded, but ingestion through each library's writer API is timed. Timestamp columns are handed to every writer as logical DateTime values, so the conversion each library performs is timed. String columns are handed to Plank and ParquetSharp pre-encoded; Parquet.Net has no pre-encoded entry point and encodes inside the timed region.
